raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The optional PD KV checksum (`--disaggregation-enable-kv-checksum`) digests the prefill rank's complete local KV for a request, and the decode rank re-digests its own local KV when the request enters a batch. That comparison only holds when both ranks hold the same bytes. Under a TP width mismatch between prefill and decode, a decode rank receives a head slice of what one prefill rank digested, or a concatenation of slices from several prefill ranks, so every request is reported as corrupted and aborted even though the transfer is correct.

The transfer backend is the component that knows, per prefill peer, whether the two layouts match. This PR gives it a way to say so.

## Modifications

- `BaseKVManager.should_verify_kv_checksum(bootstrap_addr) -> bool`, defaulting to `True`. A backend returns `False` for a peer whose digest is not comparable with this rank's local KV.
- `SchedulerDisaggregationDecodeMixin._verify_kv_checksums` consults the decode prealloc queue's KV manager before digesting a request and admits the request unverified when the backend answers `False`. Health checks and a zero expected checksum keep their existing fast paths; the in-tree backends keep the default and are unchanged.
- `test_kv_checksum.py`: a new case admits one request through the hook while a sibling with a bad digest is still aborted, which also exercises the index-based batch filtering on the skip path. The fake scheduler and request gain the prealloc queue and bootstrap address the production path reads.

https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39729 proposes a layout signature carried in the metadata row to guard such topologies generically; this hook is the smaller per-backend opt-out and composes with it.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no change to model outputs. The checksum is a diagnostic that is off by default.

`python -m pytest test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_kv_checksum.py` on one NVIDIA GPU: 18 passed (17 existing + 1 new). The new case fails without the decode-side hook and also fails if the skip path appends the request instead of its index, so it guards both.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -129,6 +129,13 @@ class BaseKVManager(ABC):
     enable_deferred_decode_kv_release: bool = False
     supports_host_destination: bool = False
 
+    def should_verify_kv_checksum(self, bootstrap_addr: str) -> bool:
+        """Whether the checksum sent by the prefill at bootstrap_addr is comparable
+        with one over this rank's local KV. A backend returns False for a peer
+        whose digest covers a different byte range, e.g. a TP width mismatch where
+        each decode rank receives only a slice of what the sender digested."""
+        return True
+
     @abstractmethod
     def __init__(
         self,

@@ -3200,11 +3200,15 @@ def _verify_kv_checksums(self, batch: ScheduleBatch) -> None:
         if computer is None:
             return
 
+        kv_manager = self.disagg_decode_prealloc_queue.kv_manager
         verified: List[int] = []
         for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):
             if is_health_check_req(req):
                 verified.append(i)
                 continue
+            if not kv_manager.should_verify_kv_checksum(_bootstrap_addr(req)):
+                verified.append(i)
+                continue
             expected = req.expected_kv_checksum
             if expected == 0:
                 verified.append(i)

@@ -207,6 +207,11 @@ def __init__(self, computer, req_to_token):
         self.ngram_embedding_manager = Mock()
         self.chunked_req = None
         self.future_map = None
+        self.disagg_decode_prealloc_queue = SimpleNamespace(
+            kv_manager=SimpleNamespace(
+                should_verify_kv_checksum=lambda bootstrap_addr: True
+            )
+        )
 
     def stream_output(self, reqs, return_logprob):
         self.streamed_aborts.extend(reqs)
@@ -218,9 +223,11 @@ def __init__(self):
         self.disagg_metadata_buffers = SimpleNamespace(set_kv_checksum=Mock())
 
 
-def _make_req(expected_chksum, num_input_tokens, rid="r0"):
+def _make_req(expected_chksum, num_input_tokens, rid="r0", bootstrap_host="127.0.0.1"):
     return SimpleNamespace(
         rid=rid,
+        bootstrap_host=bootstrap_host,
+        bootstrap_port=8998,
         bootstrap_room=12345,
         kv=SimpleNamespace(req_pool_idx=0),
         origin_input_ids=list(range(num_input_tokens)),
@@ -356,6 +363,29 @@ def test_zero_expected_skips_checksum(self):
         sched.waiting_queue = [_make_req(0, self.num_pages)]
         self.assertEqual(len(self._run_once(sched).reqs), 1)
 
+    def test_backend_can_skip_incomparable_checksum(self):
+        """A request whose sender the backend declares incomparable is admitted
+        without a digest, decided per bootstrap address, and skipping it must not
+        disturb the index-based filtering of a mismatching sibling."""
+        sched = self._make_sched(_SENTINEL)
+        sched.disagg_decode_prealloc_queue.kv_manager.should_verify_kv_checksum = (
+            lambda bootstrap_addr: not bootstrap_addr.startswith("10.0.0.1:")
+        )
+        aborted = _make_req(0xDEADBEEF, self.num_pages, rid="aborted")
+        skipped = _make_req(
+            0xDEADBEEF, self.num_pages, rid="skipped", bootstrap_host="10.0.0.1"
+        )
+        sched.waiting_queue = [aborted, skipped]
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_IS_IN_CI.override(False),
+            patch("sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode.prepare_abort") as mock_abort,
+            patch("sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode.release_kv_cache"),
+        ):
+            batch = self._run_once(sched)
+        self.assertEqual(batch.reqs, [skipped])
+        self.assertEqual(sched.streamed_aborts, [aborted])
+        mock_abort.assert_called_once()
+
 
 _SENTINEL = object()
